specs.title: 法国概览与目录
specs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity polished Chinese children's geographic encyclopedia Flutter app 世界大百科, for age 8. Modern photographic geographic field guide. White backgrounds, pale #F4F7FB panels, deep navy #12395B typography, orange #FF9A3D action buttons. Clean Noto Sans SC Chinese, generous 18dp reading size, 16dp card radius, restrained editorial layout, elegant line icons. NOT cartoon, no mascots, no flag decoration, no device frames or perspective. TWO complete flat mobile artboards side by side on pale background, each 390x844 proportions. All screens fully visible. Short exact readable simplified Chinese text, no lorem ipsum or dense fake text. Photorealistic scenic image placeholders inside UI; tiny board footer 法国模块 · 界面概念设计. Any map is labeled 示意. Photos are concept placeholders for later licensed photography. Consistent reader bottom bar 目录 / 听讲解 / 收藏 / 笔记. LEFT overview: spectacular daytime photograph of Paris Seine riverside with Eiffel Tower in credible distance, blue sky and riverside trees. Title 法国 / FRANCE / 从塞纳河走向山海. Below white rounded content 先认识法国. Fact strip 巴黎 / 欧洲与海外 / 法语. Three photographic route cards 河岸里的城市, 山海的变化, 物件里的时间. Two question rows 海水为什么会回来？ and 法国只在欧洲吗？. Orange fixed bottom CTA 从塞纳河开始. RIGHT 法国 · 探索目录, subtitle 带着问题去探索, three photo mosaic Paris river, Mont Saint Michel tidal island, Alpine glacier. Ten balanced tiles exactly 国家名片 / 地理与气候 / 人们与语言 / 日常生活 / 饮食与物产 / 艺术与节日 / 城市与地标 / 动物与生态 / 历史故事 / 有趣问题. Navy action 打开法国地图. Keep overview not overcrowded.
